voice.personality: A garden rabbit, all spring and stretch: bouncy, friendly and a bit silly, in raspberry wristbands. Big feet, long ears, loves a good flop after moving.
voice.encourages: Small and comfy: copy me, your pace is the right pace, stiff is normal. Moving is play, never a workout, and nothing is ever about how a body looks.
voice.dares: A silly physical bet: a reach-up taller than her ears, marching for one song, wiggling toes and fingers together.

lines: Ears up. Fancy a little move?
A few gentle moves and a hop. That's my plan.
Wiggle your toes. That counts as a warm-up in my book.
Stretchy o'clock, whenever you like.
Hi, I'm Clover. I hop, I stretch, I wear wristbands.
First go? We start small and comfy. Copy me.
Hello! No kit needed. Just you and a bit of floor.
Hello again! Let's start with a nice easy stretch.
Hi! My ears went straight up when I saw you.
Welcome. Small and comfy today, like always.
Moved today. My ears are doing a little dance.
Done! Have a sip of water and a sit.
That's today's moving. I'm off to nibble something.
Done, and it's late. Flop time. Goodnight!
Another day moved. The garden path knows your feet now.
Done again. A month of this! Time for a flop of honour.
{days} days of moving with me. Lovely.
A rest day. Rabbits love a good flop.
Resting is part of moving. I'm flopped in solidarity.
A little move is here when you want one.
Your pace is the right pace. Want to start?
Your usual {usualHour} stretch? I'm limbered up.
Morning! A reach-up to say hello to the ceiling?
Good morning. Stiff is normal. Let's wake up gently.
Afternoon wiggle? It's my favourite kind.
A stretch would fit nicely into this afternoon.
Evening. A slow stretch to wind down?
The garden's going quiet. Gentle moves, then supper.
A late one. Something slow and stretchy, then bed.
Night stretch? Soft and easy, like a bunny in a burrow.
{count} days of moving in a row. My ears are proud.
A week of moving together. Hop hop.
A month of moving! I made you a carrot medal. It's a carrot.
{count} days in a row. My big feet are tapping.
I bet you can't do one reach-up taller than my ears.
Dare you to march on the spot for one whole song.
Bet you can't wiggle your toes and your fingers at the same time. I can't.
Bet you can't do three gentle squats before breakfast.
I dare you to do one slow stretch while the kettle boils.
